SELECT 
        lt.MemberId, 
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN lt.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate 
                AND lt.TransactionTypeId IN (4,10,12,43) 
                AND (lt.IsReversed = 0 OR lt.Credit > 0) 
            THEN lt.TransactionDate 
        END) AS LastLoanPaymentDate
    INTO #LoanTransaction
    FROM #FilteredLoanAccount la
    INNER JOIN program.LoanTransaction lt WITH(NOLOCK) ON lt.AccountId = la.Id AND lt.BranchId = @BranchId
    WHERE la.DisburseDate <= @AsOnDate
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM program.LoanTransaction lt2 WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE lt2.ReferenceTransactionId = lt.Id 
                AND lt2.IsReversed = 1
                AND lt2.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate
        )
    GROUP BY lt.MemberId
    OPTION (MAXDOP 8)

SELECT 
        bd.MemberId, 
        bd.DisburseDate,
        COALESCE(bd.LastLoanPaymentDate, loan.LastLoanPaymentDate) AS LastLoanPaymentDate,
        bd.PresentBadDebt
    INTO #BadDebtTransaction 
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            mh.MemberId, 
            CASE WHEN bda.Status = 1 OR (bda.Status = 0 AND bda.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate) 
                THEN bda.DisburseDate 
            END AS DisburseDate,
            MAX(CASE 
                WHEN bdt.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate 
                    AND bdt.TransactionTypeId IN (9,63) 
                    AND (bdt.IsReversed = 0 OR bdt.Credit > 0) 
                THEN bdt.TransactionDate 
            END) AS LastLoanPaymentDate,
            SUM(CASE 
                WHEN (bda.Status = 1 OR (bda.Status = 0 AND bda.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate)) 
                    AND bdt.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate 
                    AND (bdt.IsReversed = 0 OR bdt.Credit > 0) 
                THEN bdt.Debit - bdt.Credit 
            END) AS PresentBadDebt
        FROM #MoveHistory mh
        INNER JOIN program.BadDebtAccount bda WITH(NOLOCK) ON bda.MemberId = mh.MemberId
        INNER JOIN program.BadDebtTransaction bdt WITH(NOLOCK) ON bdt.AccountId = bda.id
        WHERE bdt.BranchId = @BranchId 
            AND bda.BadDebtTransferDate <= @AsOnDate
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM program.BadDebtTransaction bdt2 WITH(NOLOCK)
                WHERE bdt2.ReferenceTransactionId = bdt.Id 
                    AND bdt2.IsReversed = 1
                    AND bdt2.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate
            )
        GROUP BY mh.MemberId, bda.DisburseDate, bda.Status, bda.ClosingDate
    ) bd
    LEFT JOIN #LoanTransaction loan ON loan.MemberId = bd.MemberId 
    OPTION (MAXDOP 8)

SELECT 
        sa.MemberId, 
        MAX(CASE WHEN st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate THEN st.TransactionDate END) AS LastSavingsPaymentDate,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sa.CategoryId = 4 AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate THEN st.TransactionDate ELSE 0 END) AS LastSecurityPaymentDate,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN (sa.Status = 1 OR (sa.Status = 0 AND sa.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate)) 
                AND sa.CategoryId = 2 
                AND sa.ProductId <> 204 
                AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate 
            THEN st.Credit - st.Debit 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS PresentGeneralSavings,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN (sa.Status = 1 OR (sa.Status = 0 AND sa.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate)) 
                AND sa.CategoryId = 3 
                AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate 
            THEN st.Credit - st.Debit 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS [Present CBS],
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN (sa.Status = 1 OR (sa.Status = 0 AND sa.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate)) 
                AND sa.CategoryId = 4 
                AND sa.ProductId = 4 
                AND st.TransactionDate <= @AsOnDate 
            THEN st.Credit - st.Debit 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS [Present Total LTS Balance]
    INTO #SavingsTransaction
    FROM #MoveHistory mh
    INNER JOIN program.SavingsAccount sa WITH(NOLOCK) ON sa.MemberId = mh.MemberId

SELECT

        la.IsPrimary, 
        la.DisburseDate,

        la.Id,

        la.DisburseDate,
        ISNULL(SUM(la.DisburseAmount), 0) AS PresentLoan,
        0 AS PresentOverdue

    WHERE (la.Status = 1 OR (la.Status = 0 AND la.ClosingDate > @AsOnDate))

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1

    GROUP BY la.Id, la.MemberId, la.IsPrimary, la.DisburseDate

antiPatterns.title: Implicit Data Type Conversions
antiPatterns.description: SQL Server is performing CONVERT_IMPLICIT on column expressions, invalidating index seeks and distorting cardinality estimations.
antiPatterns.recommendation: Align parameter and variable data types with the underlying column data types (e.g. check INT vs SMALLINT/TINYINT or VARCHAR vs NVARCHAR).

antiPatterns.title: Single Threaded Execution (MaxDOP = 1)
antiPatterns.description: The query plan is forced to run on a single CPU core because MaxDOP is set to 1 at the server, database, or resource governor level.
antiPatterns.recommendation: Consider setting Cost Threshold for Parallelism (e.g. 50) and MAXDOP based on NUMA core architecture rather than forcing MAXDOP 1 globally.

antiPatterns.title: Heavy Key / RID Lookups
antiPatterns.description: Index seeks are followed by thousands of per-row lookups into the base table to fetch columns the index does not contain.
antiPatterns.recommendation: Add the fetched columns to the driving index with INCLUDE, or create a covering index.
